markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set, MUSK and neighbors all agree [F1]; image sits at the 94th OOD percentile.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Reliable; flag not raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce glands; low score tracks invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Little benign stroma; low score tracks invasive · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; higher values track invasive · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 0, 4, 8) · context · TILs above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) or atypical appearance distorts concept scores and features.
- Calibration is dataset-level (132 images); ECE CI reaches 0.18, so 99% may overstate.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6, 10** — lowest per-region invasive risk (14%, 10%, 21%); check for benign or in situ areas.
2. **Region 5** — confirm scarce glands and little benign stroma.
3. **Regions 0, 3, 8, 11** — corners; confirm the suggested tumor-at-margin call [F7].
